reviews.title: I love this mouse!
reviews.comment:
I love this mouse! I have large hands and the mouse feels very nice and ergonomical in my hand.
The adjustable DPI is nice for switching between FPSs and other games like WoW or Civilization where I like different sensitivities.
Finally, the optical laser or whatever is great. I haven't found a surface it doesnt work on yet, often I just use the arm of my couch instead of a mousepad and it still works perfectly.
Great mouse for gaming if you dont need a bunch of extra buttons for your thumb like some have.
reviews.author: Jack B

reviews.title: Does what it does
reviews.comment: On the "smaller" side for a mouse these days, I've been using this model for... a fair amount of years and it's still my goto mouse. If you need something with more buttons, there are mice out there for you. This is as basic as I will go that has side buttons and capable of changing DPI on the fly.
reviews.author: Stephen Wong Jr.

reviews.title: Solid
reviews.comment: Pleasantly pleased with this product. First “gaming” mouse that I have purchased and boy has it been a great addition. The RGB integration that Razer has is fantastic, and the performance is better than I expected. Would for sure recommend.
reviews.author: Tyler Clough

reviews.title: Best Gaming Mouse Ever /endthread
reviews.comment: Dont even keep looking, you already found it. This IS the one you have been searching your entire night for. The hand fits so smoothly along the mouse, and with 2 thumb buttons website navigation is a breeze. Only downside is I only purchase new ones when the grip comes off because the glue fades away, this takes about a year or 2
